measures.name: MTTA
measures.expression:
VAR AckMinutesTable =
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        Fact_Incident,
        "@AckMin", DATEDIFF(Fact_Incident[OpenedDateTime], Fact_Incident[AcknowledgedDateTime], MINUTE)
    )
RETURN
    AVERAGEX(AckMinutesTable, [@AckMin])

measures.name: MTTR
measures.expression:
VAR ResolveMinutesTable =
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        Fact_Incident,
        "@ResolveMin", DATEDIFF(Fact_Incident[OpenedDateTime], Fact_Incident[ResolvedDateTime], MINUTE)
    )
RETURN
    AVERAGEX(ResolveMinutesTable, [@ResolveMin])

measures.name: Incident Count
measures.expression: COUNTROWS(Fact_Incident)

measures.name: SLA Breach Count
measures.description: Incidents that breached their acknowledge or resolve SLA (BreachFlag = 1) in the selected period. Renamed from "Open Breach Count" in Phase 5: it has always counted every breached incident, open or resolved.
measures.expression:
CALCULATE(
    COUNTROWS(Fact_Incident),
    Fact_Incident[BreachFlag] = 1
)

measures.name: Breach Rate %
measures.expression:
VAR TotalIncidents = [Incident Count]
VAR BreachedIncidents = [SLA Breach Count]
RETURN
    DIVIDE(BreachedIncidents, TotalIncidents)

measures.name: Escalation Count
measures.expression:
CALCULATE(
    COUNTROWS(Fact_Incident),
    Fact_Incident[EscalatedFlag] = 1
)

measures.name: After-Hours Incident Share %
measures.expression:
VAR TotalIncidents = [Incident Count]
VAR AfterHoursIncidents =
    CALCULATE(
        COUNTROWS(Fact_Incident),
        HOUR(Fact_Incident[OpenedDateTime]) >= 19
            || HOUR(Fact_Incident[OpenedDateTime]) < 7
    )
RETURN
    DIVIDE(AfterHoursIncidents, TotalIncidents)

measures.name: Breach Age Days
measures.description: Ageing bucket measures for currently-open SLA breaches, bucketed by days since open (0-1 / 1-3 / 3-7 / 7+).
measures.expression:
AVERAGEX(
    FILTER(Fact_Incident, Fact_Incident[BreachFlag] = 1),
    DATEDIFF(Fact_Incident[OpenedDateTime], Fact_Incident[ResolvedDateTime], DAY)
)

measures.name: Breaches 0-1 Day
measures.expression:
VAR BreachAgeTable =
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        FILTER(Fact_Incident, Fact_Incident[BreachFlag] = 1),
        "@AgeDays", DATEDIFF(Fact_Incident[OpenedDateTime], Fact_Incident[ResolvedDateTime], DAY)
    )
RETURN
    COUNTROWS(FILTER(BreachAgeTable, [@AgeDays] >= 0 && [@AgeDays] <= 1))

measures.name: Breaches 1-3 Days
measures.expression:
VAR BreachAgeTable =
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        FILTER(Fact_Incident, Fact_Incident[BreachFlag] = 1),
        "@AgeDays", DATEDIFF(Fact_Incident[OpenedDateTime], Fact_Incident[ResolvedDateTime], DAY)
    )
RETURN
    COUNTROWS(FILTER(BreachAgeTable, [@AgeDays] > 1 && [@AgeDays] <= 3))

measures.name: Breaches 3-7 Days
measures.expression:
VAR BreachAgeTable =
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        FILTER(Fact_Incident, Fact_Incident[BreachFlag] = 1),
        "@AgeDays", DATEDIFF(Fact_Incident[OpenedDateTime], Fact_Incident[ResolvedDateTime], DAY)
    )
RETURN
    COUNTROWS(FILTER(BreachAgeTable, [@AgeDays] > 3 && [@AgeDays] <= 7))

measures.name: Breaches 7+ Days
measures.expression:
VAR BreachAgeTable =
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        FILTER(Fact_Incident, Fact_Incident[BreachFlag] = 1),
        "@AgeDays", DATEDIFF(Fact_Incident[OpenedDateTime], Fact_Incident[ResolvedDateTime], DAY)
    )
RETURN
    COUNTROWS(FILTER(BreachAgeTable, [@AgeDays] > 7))

measures.name: Ack Target Minutes
measures.description: Acknowledge SLA in minutes by severity (Sev1 15 / Sev2 30 / Sev3 60 / Sev4 120 - see "Assumptions"), averaged over the incidents in context, so at portfolio level it is the target weighted by the actual severity mix and directly comparable to [MTTA].
measures.expression: AVERAGEX(Fact_Incident, SWITCH(Fact_Incident[Severity], "Sev1", 15, "Sev2", 30, "Sev3", 60, 120))

measures.name: Resolve Target Hours
measures.description: Resolve SLA in hours by severity (4 / 8 / 24 / 72h), averaged over the incidents in context - comparable to [MTTR Hours].
measures.expression: DIVIDE(AVERAGEX(Fact_Incident, SWITCH(Fact_Incident[Severity], "Sev1", 240, "Sev2", 480, "Sev3", 1440, 4320)), 60)

measures.name: MTTR Hours
measures.expression: DIVIDE([MTTR], 60)

measures.name: Acknowledged Within SLA %
measures.description: Share of incidents acknowledged within their own severity's acknowledge SLA.
measures.expression:
VAR IncidentTargets =
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        Fact_Incident,
        "@AckMin", DATEDIFF(Fact_Incident[OpenedDateTime], Fact_Incident[AcknowledgedDateTime], MINUTE),
        "@TargetMin", SWITCH(Fact_Incident[Severity], "Sev1", 15, "Sev2", 30, "Sev3", 60, 120)
    )
RETURN
    DIVIDE(COUNTROWS(FILTER(IncidentTargets, [@AckMin] <= [@TargetMin])), COUNTROWS(IncidentTargets))

measures.name: Resolved Within SLA %
measures.description: Share of incidents resolved within their own severity's resolve SLA.
measures.expression:
VAR IncidentTargets =
    ADDCOLUMNS(
        Fact_Incident,
        "@ResolveMin", DATEDIFF(Fact_Incident[OpenedDateTime], Fact_Incident[ResolvedDateTime], MINUTE),
        "@TargetMin", SWITCH(Fact_Incident[Severity], "Sev1", 240, "Sev2", 480, "Sev3", 1440, 4320)
    )
RETURN
    DIVIDE(COUNTROWS(FILTER(IncidentTargets, [@ResolveMin] <= [@TargetMin])), COUNTROWS(IncidentTargets))

measures.name: Escalation Rate %
measures.expression: DIVIDE([Escalation Count], [Incident Count])

measures.name: Breach Rate % - Prior Period
measures.expression:
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodDays = INT(PeriodEnd - PeriodStart) + 1
RETURN
    CALCULATE([Breach Rate %], REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Date), DATESBETWEEN(Dim_Date[Date], PeriodStart - PeriodDays, PeriodStart - 1))

measures.name: Acknowledged Within SLA % - Prior Period
measures.expression:
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodDays = INT(PeriodEnd - PeriodStart) + 1
RETURN
    CALCULATE([Acknowledged Within SLA %], REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Date), DATESBETWEEN(Dim_Date[Date], PeriodStart - PeriodDays, PeriodStart - 1))

measures.name: Shifts Required
measures.expression: COUNTROWS(Fact_OnCallRoster)

measures.name: Shifts Covered
measures.expression:
CALCULATE(
    COUNTROWS(Fact_OnCallRoster),
    Fact_OnCallRoster[CoveredFlag] = 1
)

measures.name: On-Call Coverage %
measures.expression:
VAR RequiredShifts = [Shifts Required]
VAR CoveredShifts = [Shifts Covered]
RETURN
    DIVIDE(CoveredShifts, RequiredShifts)

measures.name: Coverage Gap Count
measures.expression:
VAR RequiredShifts = [Shifts Required]
VAR CoveredShifts = [Shifts Covered]
RETURN
    RequiredShifts - CoveredShifts

measures.name: After-Hours Shift Share %
measures.expression:
VAR TotalShifts = [Shifts Required]
VAR AfterHoursShifts =
    CALCULATE(
        COUNTROWS(Fact_OnCallRoster),
        Fact_OnCallRoster[AfterHoursFlag] = 1
    )
RETURN
    DIVIDE(AfterHoursShifts, TotalShifts)

measures.name: Total Uptime Minutes
measures.expression: SUM(Fact_Uptime[UptimeMinutes])

measures.name: Total Downtime Minutes
measures.expression: SUM(Fact_Uptime[DowntimeMinutes])

measures.name: Availability %
measures.description: Availability % = uptime minutes / total elapsed minutes across all in-context application-days.
measures.expression:
VAR UptimeMin = [Total Uptime Minutes]
VAR DowntimeMin = [Total Downtime Minutes]
VAR TotalMin = UptimeMin + DowntimeMin
RETURN
    DIVIDE(UptimeMin, TotalMin)

measures.name: Uptime Attainment vs Target %
measures.expression:
VAR ActualAvailability = [Availability %]
VAR TargetAvailability = AVERAGE(Dim_Application[CommittedUptimeTarget])
RETURN
    DIVIDE(ActualAvailability, TargetAvailability)

measures.name: Uptime RAG Status
measures.description: RAG status vs committed uptime target: Green at or above target, Amber within 0.10pp, Red below.
measures.expression:
VAR ActualAvailability = [Availability %]
VAR TargetAvailability = AVERAGE(Dim_Application[CommittedUptimeTarget])
VAR Gap = ActualAvailability - TargetAvailability
RETURN
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        ISBLANK(ActualAvailability), "No Data",
        Gap >= 0, "Green",
        Gap >= -0.001, "Amber",
        "Red"
    )

measures.name: MTBF
measures.description: MTBF in hours = total uptime hours in period / number of distinct outage events in period.
measures.expression:
VAR UptimeHours = [Total Uptime Minutes] / 60
VAR OutageEvents = DISTINCTCOUNT(Fact_Uptime[OutageEventKey])
RETURN
    DIVIDE(UptimeHours, OutageEvents)

measures.name: Outage Event Count
measures.expression: DISTINCTCOUNT(Fact_Uptime[OutageEventKey])

measures.name: Availability % - Prior Period
measures.description: Availability over the equal-length window immediately before the selected period. (Previously DATEADD -1 MONTH, which for a full-year selection compared against an 11-of-12-months-overlapping window.)
measures.expression:
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodDays = INT(PeriodEnd - PeriodStart) + 1
RETURN
    CALCULATE([Availability %], REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Date), DATESBETWEEN(Dim_Date[Date], PeriodStart - PeriodDays, PeriodStart - 1))

measures.name: Availability % Change vs Prior Period
measures.expression:
VAR CurrentPeriodAvailability = [Availability %]
VAR PriorPeriodAvailability = [Availability % - Prior Period]
RETURN
    CurrentPeriodAvailability - PriorPeriodAvailability

measures.name: Data as of
measures.description: Header text: last date with loaded uptime data (data currency, ignores slicers) plus the selected reporting period.
measures.expression:
VAR LastLoadedDate = CALCULATE(MAX(Fact_Uptime[Date]), REMOVEFILTERS())
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Dim_Date[Date])
RETURN
    "Data as of " & FORMAT(LastLoadedDate, "mmm d, yyyy")
        & "  ·  Period " & FORMAT(PeriodStart, "mmm d, yyyy") & " – " & FORMAT(PeriodEnd, "mmm d, yyyy")

measures.name: Open Incident Count
measures.description: Incidents still unresolved at the END of the selected period (backlog at period close). Measured against the period end rather than NOW(), which sits after the synthetic data and always returned blank.
measures.expression:
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Dim_Date[Date])
RETURN
    CALCULATE(
        [Incident Count],
        REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Date),
        Fact_Incident[OpenedDate] <= PeriodEnd,
        Fact_Incident[ResolvedDateTime] >= PeriodEnd + 1
            || ISBLANK(Fact_Incident[ResolvedDateTime])
    )

measures.name: Open Sev1-2 Incidents
measures.expression: CALCULATE([Open Incident Count], Fact_Incident[Severity] IN {"Sev1", "Sev2"})

measures.name: Committed Uptime Target %
measures.description: Average committed uptime SLA of the applications in context - the same target basis [Uptime RAG Status] uses.
measures.expression: AVERAGE(Dim_Application[CommittedUptimeTarget])

measures.name: Availability Gap vs Target (pp)
measures.description: Actual availability minus committed target, in percentage points (negative = below SLA).
measures.expression:
VAR ActualAvailability = [Availability %]
VAR TargetAvailability = [Committed Uptime Target %]
RETURN
    IF(NOT ISBLANK(ActualAvailability), (ActualAvailability - TargetAvailability) * 100)

measures.name: Downtime Hours
measures.expression: DIVIDE([Total Downtime Minutes], 60)

measures.name: Applications in Scope
measures.expression: COUNTROWS(FILTER(VALUES(Dim_Application[ApplicationKey]), NOT ISBLANK([Availability %])))

measures.name: Applications Meeting SLA
measures.description: Applications whose own availability met their own committed target (evaluated per application, not on the portfolio average).

measures.name: Applications Below SLA
measures.description: Applications more than 0.10pp below their committed target (Red on [Uptime RAG Status]).

measures.name: SLA Compliance Label
measures.expression:
VAR Meeting = [Applications Meeting SLA]
VAR InScope = [Applications in Scope]
RETURN
    IF(InScope > 0, FORMAT(Meeting + 0, "0") & " of " & FORMAT(InScope, "0"))

measures.name: Customer-Impacting Outages
measures.description: Outage events flagged customer-impacting whose OutageDate falls in the selected period. Dim_OutageEvent has no date relationship, so the period is applied virtually with TREATAS.
measures.expression:
CALCULATE(
    COUNTROWS(Dim_OutageEvent),
    Dim_OutageEvent[CustomerImpacting] = 1,
    TREATAS(VALUES(Dim_Date[Date]), Dim_OutageEvent[OutageDate])
)

measures.name: MTBF - Prior Period
measures.description: MTBF over the equal-length window immediately before the selected period (e.g. 2024 when 2025 is selected).
measures.expression:
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodDays = INT(PeriodEnd - PeriodStart) + 1
RETURN
    CALCULATE([MTBF], REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Date), DATESBETWEEN(Dim_Date[Date], PeriodStart - PeriodDays, PeriodStart - 1))

measures.name: Outage Event Count - Prior Period
measures.expression:
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodDays = INT(PeriodEnd - PeriodStart) + 1
RETURN
    CALCULATE([Outage Event Count], REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Date), DATESBETWEEN(Dim_Date[Date], PeriodStart - PeriodDays, PeriodStart - 1))

measures.name: Availability Status
measures.description: KPI status line: icon + word + gap to SLA. Thresholds identical to [Uptime RAG Status].
measures.expression:
VAR Gap = [Availability Gap vs Target (pp)]
VAR Target = [Committed Uptime Target %]
VAR Label =
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        Gap >= 0, "✓ On target",
        Gap >= -0.10, "⚠ At risk",
        "✕ Below SLA"
    )
RETURN
    IF(ISBLANK(Gap), "– No data", Label & "  ·  " & FORMAT(Gap, "+0.00;-0.00;0.00") & " pp vs " & FORMAT(Target, "0.00%") & " SLA")

measures.name: Availability Status Color
measures.expression:
VAR Gap = [Availability Gap vs Target (pp)]
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Gap), "#5A6775", Gap >= 0, "#1E7B3C", Gap >= -0.10, "#8A5A00", "#B42318")

measures.name: Uptime Status Label
measures.description: Row-level status for tables/matrices: icon + word derived from [Uptime RAG Status].
measures.expression:
SWITCH(
    [Uptime RAG Status],
    "Green", "✓ On target",
    "Amber", "⚠ At risk",
    "Red", "✕ Below SLA",
    "– No data"
)

measures.name: Uptime Status Color
measures.description: Text colour for [Uptime Status Label] / gap columns (AA contrast on white).
measures.expression: SWITCH([Uptime RAG Status], "Green", "#1E7B3C", "Amber", "#8A5A00", "Red", "#B42318", "#5A6775")

measures.name: Uptime Status Fill
measures.description: Bar/gauge fill colour for the same RAG status.
measures.expression: SWITCH([Uptime RAG Status], "Green", "#2E7D46", "Amber", "#C07F12", "Red", "#B42318", "#B8C2CC")

measures.name: SLA Compliance Status
measures.expression:
VAR Below = [Applications Below SLA] + 0
VAR AtRisk = [Applications in Scope] - [Applications Meeting SLA] - Below
RETURN
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        ISBLANK([Applications in Scope]), "– No data",
        Below > 0, "✕ " & Below & " below SLA  ·  " & AtRisk & " at risk",
        AtRisk > 0, "⚠ " & AtRisk & " at risk (within 0.10 pp)",
        "✓ All applications meet SLA"
    )

measures.name: SLA Compliance Status Color
measures.expression:
VAR Below = [Applications Below SLA] + 0
VAR Missing = [Applications in Scope] - [Applications Meeting SLA]
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK([Applications in Scope]), "#5A6775", Below > 0, "#B42318", Missing > 0, "#8A5A00", "#1E7B3C")

measures.name: MTBF Status
measures.expression:
VAR CurrentPeriodMTBF = [MTBF]
VAR PriorPeriodMTBF = [MTBF - Prior Period]
VAR Change = DIVIDE(CurrentPeriodMTBF - PriorPeriodMTBF, PriorPeriodMTBF)
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(PriorPeriodMTBF) || ISBLANK(CurrentPeriodMTBF),
        "– No prior period in data",
        SWITCH(TRUE(), Change >= 0, "✓ ▲ ", Change >= -0.10, "⚠ ▼ ", "✕ ▼ ")
            & FORMAT(Change, "+0.0%;-0.0%") & " vs prior period (higher is better)"
    )

measures.name: MTBF Status Color
measures.expression:
VAR PriorPeriodMTBF = [MTBF - Prior Period]
VAR Change = DIVIDE([MTBF] - PriorPeriodMTBF, PriorPeriodMTBF)
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(PriorPeriodMTBF), "#5A6775", Change >= 0, "#1E7B3C", Change >= -0.10, "#8A5A00", "#B42318")

measures.name: Outage Status
measures.description: Outage volume vs the prior equal-length period (lower is better) plus the customer-impacting count.
measures.expression:
VAR CurrentPeriodOutages = [Outage Event Count] + 0
VAR PriorPeriodOutages = [Outage Event Count - Prior Period]
VAR Change = DIVIDE(CurrentPeriodOutages - PriorPeriodOutages, PriorPeriodOutages)
VAR Impacting = [Customer-Impacting Outages] + 0
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(PriorPeriodOutages),
        Impacting & " customer-impacting",
        SWITCH(TRUE(), Change <= 0, "✓ ▼ ", Change <= 0.10, "⚠ ▲ ", "✕ ▲ ")
            & FORMAT(Change, "+0%;-0%") & " vs prior  ·  " & Impacting & " customer-impacting"
    )

measures.name: Outage Status Color
measures.expression:
VAR PriorPeriodOutages = [Outage Event Count - Prior Period]
VAR Change = DIVIDE([Outage Event Count] - PriorPeriodOutages, PriorPeriodOutages)
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(PriorPeriodOutages), "#5A6775", Change <= 0, "#1E7B3C", Change <= 0.10, "#8A5A00", "#B42318")

measures.name: Open Incident Status
measures.expression:
VAR HighSeverityOpen = [Open Sev1-2 Incidents] + 0
VAR AllOpen = [Open Incident Count] + 0
RETURN
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        HighSeverityOpen > 0, "✕ " & HighSeverityOpen & " Sev1/Sev2 still open at period end",
        AllOpen > 0, "⚠ No Sev1/Sev2 open  ·  " & AllOpen & " lower-severity open",
        "✓ No incidents open at period end"
    )

measures.name: Open Incident Status Color
measures.expression: SWITCH(TRUE(), [Open Sev1-2 Incidents] + 0 > 0, "#B42318", [Open Incident Count] + 0 > 0, "#8A5A00", "#1E7B3C")

measures.name: Ack SLA Target %
measures.description: Service target: 90% of incidents acknowledged within their severity SLA (assumed - not disclosed in the case study).

measures.name: Breach Rate Target %
measures.description: Service target: no more than 20% of incidents breaching an SLA (assumed).

measures.name: Escalation Rate Target %
measures.description: Service target: no more than 5% of incidents escalated (assumed).

measures.name: MTTA Status
measures.description: MTTA against the severity-mix-weighted acknowledge target: within = on target, up to 25% over = at risk.
measures.expression:
VAR Actual = [MTTA]
VAR Target = [Ack Target Minutes]
VAR Ratio = DIVIDE(Actual, Target)
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(Actual),
        "– No data",
        SWITCH(TRUE(), Ratio <= 1, "✓ Within target", Ratio <= 1.25, "⚠ Over target", "✕ Well over target")
            & "  ·  " & FORMAT(Actual, "0") & " vs " & FORMAT(Target, "0") & " min mix-weighted SLA"
    )

measures.name: MTTA Status Color
measures.expression:
VAR Ratio = DIVIDE([MTTA], [Ack Target Minutes])
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Ratio), "#5A6775", Ratio <= 1, "#1E7B3C", Ratio <= 1.25, "#8A5A00", "#B42318")

measures.name: MTTA Fill
measures.expression:
VAR Ratio = DIVIDE([MTTA], [Ack Target Minutes])
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Ratio), "#B8C2CC", Ratio <= 1, "#2E7D46", Ratio <= 1.25, "#C07F12", "#B42318")

measures.name: MTTR Status
measures.expression:
VAR Actual = [MTTR Hours]
VAR Target = [Resolve Target Hours]
VAR Ratio = DIVIDE(Actual, Target)
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(Actual),
        "– No data",
        SWITCH(TRUE(), Ratio <= 1, "✓ Within target", Ratio <= 1.25, "⚠ Over target", "✕ Well over target")
            & "  ·  " & FORMAT(Actual, "0.0") & " vs " & FORMAT(Target, "0.0") & " h mix-weighted SLA"
    )

measures.name: MTTR Status Color
measures.expression:
VAR Ratio = DIVIDE([MTTR Hours], [Resolve Target Hours])
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Ratio), "#5A6775", Ratio <= 1, "#1E7B3C", Ratio <= 1.25, "#8A5A00", "#B42318")

measures.name: Ack SLA Status
measures.expression:
VAR Actual = [Acknowledged Within SLA %]
VAR Target = [Ack SLA Target %]
VAR Prior = [Acknowledged Within SLA % - Prior Period]
VAR Trend =
    IF(NOT ISBLANK(Prior), "  ·  " & IF(Actual >= Prior, "▲ ", "▼ ") & FORMAT((Actual - Prior) * 100, "+0.0;-0.0") & " pts vs prior")
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(Actual),
        "– No data",
        SWITCH(TRUE(), Actual >= Target, "✓ Meets ", Actual >= Target - 0.05, "⚠ Below ", "✕ Below ")
            & FORMAT(Target, "0%") & " target" & Trend
    )

measures.name: Ack SLA Status Color
measures.description: Also used row-by-row (severity scorecard, application league table): >= 90% green, 85-90% amber, < 85% red.
measures.expression:
VAR Actual = [Acknowledged Within SLA %]
VAR Target = [Ack SLA Target %]
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Actual), "#5A6775", Actual >= Target, "#1E7B3C", Actual >= Target - 0.05, "#8A5A00", "#B42318")

measures.name: Breach Rate Status
measures.description: Breach rate vs the 20% ceiling (lower is better): <= 20% green, 20-30% amber, > 30% red.
measures.expression:
VAR Actual = [Breach Rate %]
VAR Target = [Breach Rate Target %]
VAR Prior = [Breach Rate % - Prior Period]
VAR Trend =
    IF(NOT ISBLANK(Prior), "  ·  " & IF(Actual <= Prior, "▼ ", "▲ ") & FORMAT((Actual - Prior) * 100, "+0.0;-0.0") & " pts vs prior")
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(Actual),
        "– No data",
        SWITCH(TRUE(), Actual <= Target, "✓ Within ", Actual <= Target + 0.10, "⚠ Above ", "✕ Above ")
            & FORMAT(Target, "0%") & " target" & Trend
    )

measures.name: Breach Rate Status Color
measures.expression:
VAR Actual = [Breach Rate %]
VAR Target = [Breach Rate Target %]
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Actual), "#5A6775", Actual <= Target, "#1E7B3C", Actual <= Target + 0.10, "#8A5A00", "#B42318")

measures.name: Escalation Status
measures.expression:
VAR Rate = [Escalation Rate %]
VAR Target = [Escalation Rate Target %]
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(Rate),
        "– No data",
        SWITCH(TRUE(), Rate <= Target, "✓ ", Rate <= Target + 0.03, "⚠ ", "✕ ")
            & FORMAT(Rate, "0.0%") & " of incidents  ·  target ≤ " & FORMAT(Target, "0%")
    )

measures.name: Escalation Status Color
measures.description: <= 5% green, 5-8% amber, > 8% red.
measures.expression:
VAR Rate = [Escalation Rate %]
VAR Target = [Escalation Rate Target %]
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Rate), "#5A6775", Rate <= Target, "#1E7B3C", Rate <= Target + 0.03, "#8A5A00", "#B42318")

measures.name: Resolve SLA Target %
measures.description: Service target: 85% of incidents resolved within their severity resolve SLA (assumed).

measures.name: Resolve SLA Status Color
measures.description: >= 85% green, 80-85% amber, < 80% red.
measures.expression:
VAR Actual = [Resolved Within SLA %]
VAR Target = [Resolve SLA Target %]
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Actual), "#5A6775", Actual >= Target, "#1E7B3C", Actual >= Target - 0.05, "#8A5A00", "#B42318")

measures.name: Outage Events in Period
measures.description: Outage events (Dim_OutageEvent rows) whose OutageDate is in the selected period - the period is applied with TREATAS because Dim_OutageEvent deliberately has no active date relationship. Used by the outage register so rows outside the period drop out.
measures.expression: CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(Dim_OutageEvent), TREATAS(VALUES(Dim_Date[Date]), Dim_OutageEvent[OutageDate]))

measures.name: Outage Minutes
measures.description: Total outage duration (minutes) of outage events in the selected period.
measures.expression: CALCULATE(SUM(Dim_OutageEvent[DurationMinutes]), TREATAS(VALUES(Dim_Date[Date]), Dim_OutageEvent[OutageDate]))

measures.name: Outage Impact Label
measures.description: Row-level impact label for the outage register (icon + words; blank outside the period).
measures.expression:
VAR Events = [Outage Events in Period]
VAR ImpactingEvents = CALCULATE([Outage Events in Period], Dim_OutageEvent[CustomerImpacting] = 1)
RETURN
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        ISBLANK(Events), BLANK(),
        ImpactingEvents = Events, "✕ Customer-impacting",
        ImpactingEvents > 0, "⚠ " & ImpactingEvents & " of " & Events & " customer-impacting",
        "– Internal only"
    )

measures.name: Outage Impact Color
measures.expression:
VAR Events = [Outage Events in Period]
VAR ImpactingEvents = CALCULATE([Outage Events in Period], Dim_OutageEvent[CustomerImpacting] = 1)
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Events), "#5A6775", ImpactingEvents = Events, "#B42318", ImpactingEvents > 0, "#8A5A00", "#5A6775")

measures.name: Selected Application Label
measures.description: Drillthrough page context line: which application (and its service line, tier and SLA) the page is showing.
measures.expression:
VAR SelectedApp = SELECTEDVALUE(Dim_Application[ApplicationName])
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(SelectedApp),
        "Multiple applications selected - drill through from a single application",
        SelectedApp & "  ·  " & SELECTEDVALUE(Dim_Application[ServiceLine]) & "  ·  "
            & SELECTEDVALUE(Dim_Application[CriticalityTier]) & "  ·  committed SLA "
            & FORMAT([Committed Uptime Target %], "0.00%")
    )

measures.name: Downtime Hours - Prior Period
measures.expression:
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodDays = INT(PeriodEnd - PeriodStart) + 1
RETURN
    CALCULATE([Downtime Hours], REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Date), DATESBETWEEN(Dim_Date[Date], PeriodStart - PeriodDays, PeriodStart - 1))

measures.name: Downtime Status
measures.expression:
VAR CurrentPeriodHours = [Downtime Hours] + 0
VAR PriorPeriodHours = [Downtime Hours - Prior Period]
VAR Change = DIVIDE(CurrentPeriodHours - PriorPeriodHours, PriorPeriodHours)
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(PriorPeriodHours),
        "– No prior period in data",
        SWITCH(TRUE(), Change <= 0, "✓ ▼ ", Change <= 0.10, "⚠ ▲ ", "✕ ▲ ")
            & FORMAT(Change, "+0%;-0%") & " vs prior period (lower is better)"
    )

measures.name: Downtime Status Color
measures.expression:
VAR PriorPeriodHours = [Downtime Hours - Prior Period]
VAR Change = DIVIDE([Downtime Hours] - PriorPeriodHours, PriorPeriodHours)
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(PriorPeriodHours), "#5A6775", Change <= 0, "#1E7B3C", Change <= 0.10, "#8A5A00", "#B42318")

measures.name: Customer Impact Status
measures.description: Customer-impacting share of outage events: none = green, under half = amber, half or more = red.
measures.expression:
VAR Impacting = [Customer-Impacting Outages] + 0
VAR Events = [Outage Events in Period] + 0
RETURN
    SWITCH(
        TRUE(),
        Events = 0, "✓ No outages in period",
        Impacting = 0, "✓ None of " & Events & " outages reached customers",
        DIVIDE(Impacting, Events) < 0.5, "⚠ " & FORMAT(DIVIDE(Impacting, Events), "0%") & " of " & Events & " outages",
        "✕ " & FORMAT(DIVIDE(Impacting, Events), "0%") & " of " & Events & " outages"
    )

measures.name: Customer Impact Status Color
measures.expression:
VAR Impacting = [Customer-Impacting Outages] + 0
VAR Events = [Outage Events in Period] + 0
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), Impacting = 0, "#1E7B3C", DIVIDE(Impacting, Events) < 0.5, "#8A5A00", "#B42318")

measures.name: Availability Gauge Min
measures.description: Gauge scale floor. The SLA band that matters is 99.5-100% (the lowest committed target is 99.5%); on a 0-100% arc every application would look identical.

measures.name: Coverage Target %
measures.description: Service target: 97% of required on-call shifts staffed (assumed). Amber tolerance 0.5pp.

measures.name: Coverage Gap vs Target (pp)
measures.description: Coverage minus the 97% target in percentage points (negative = below target).
measures.expression:
VAR Coverage = [On-Call Coverage %]
RETURN
    IF(NOT ISBLANK(Coverage), (Coverage - [Coverage Target %]) * 100)

measures.name: After-Hours Coverage %
measures.description: Coverage of after-hours (night) shifts only - the shifts where an unstaffed rota most directly delays acknowledgement.
measures.expression: CALCULATE([On-Call Coverage %], Fact_OnCallRoster[AfterHoursFlag] = 1)

measures.name: After-Hours Coverage Gaps
measures.expression: CALCULATE([Coverage Gap Count], Fact_OnCallRoster[AfterHoursFlag] = 1)

measures.name: Coverage Gap Count - Prior Period
measures.expression:
VAR PeriodStart = MIN(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodEnd = MAX(Dim_Date[Date])
VAR PeriodDays = INT(PeriodEnd - PeriodStart) + 1
RETURN
    CALCULATE([Coverage Gap Count], REMOVEFILTERS(Dim_Date), DATESBETWEEN(Dim_Date[Date], PeriodStart - PeriodDays, PeriodStart - 1))

measures.name: Coverage Status
measures.expression:
VAR Gap = [Coverage Gap vs Target (pp)]
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(Gap),
        "– No data",
        SWITCH(TRUE(), Gap >= 0, "✓ Meets", Gap >= -0.5, "⚠ Below", "✕ Below")
            & " " & FORMAT([Coverage Target %], "0%") & " target  ·  " & FORMAT(Gap, "+0.00;-0.00;0.00") & " pp"
    )

measures.name: Coverage Status Color
measures.description: Text colour for coverage vs the 97% target: >= 97% green, 96.5-97% amber, < 96.5% red. Also used row-by-row.
measures.expression:
VAR Coverage = [On-Call Coverage %]
VAR Target = [Coverage Target %]
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Coverage), "#5A6775", Coverage >= Target, "#1E7B3C", Coverage >= Target - 0.005, "#8A5A00", "#B42318")

measures.name: Coverage Fill
measures.description: Bar fill for the same coverage RAG.
measures.expression:
VAR Coverage = [On-Call Coverage %]
VAR Target = [Coverage Target %]
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Coverage), "#B8C2CC", Coverage >= Target, "#2E7D46", Coverage >= Target - 0.005, "#C07F12", "#B42318")

measures.name: Coverage Heat Color
measures.description: Light background tints for the team x shift coverage heatmap (dark text stays readable on all three).
measures.expression:
VAR Coverage = [On-Call Coverage %]
VAR Target = [Coverage Target %]
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Coverage), "#FFFFFF", Coverage >= Target, "#DDEFE2", Coverage >= Target - 0.005, "#FBEBCB", "#F6D5D1")

measures.name: Coverage Gap Status
measures.description: Unstaffed shifts vs the prior equal-length period (lower is better) and how many were after-hours.
measures.expression:
VAR Gaps = [Coverage Gap Count] + 0
VAR PriorGaps = [Coverage Gap Count - Prior Period]
VAR Change = DIVIDE(Gaps - PriorGaps, PriorGaps)
VAR AfterHours = [After-Hours Coverage Gaps] + 0
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(PriorGaps),
        AfterHours & " after-hours  ·  no prior period in data",
        SWITCH(TRUE(), Change <= 0, "✓ ▼ ", Change <= 0.10, "⚠ ▲ ", "✕ ▲ ")
            & FORMAT(Change, "+0%;-0%") & " vs prior  ·  " & AfterHours & " after-hours"
    )

measures.name: Coverage Gap Status Color
measures.expression:
VAR PriorGaps = [Coverage Gap Count - Prior Period]
VAR Change = DIVIDE([Coverage Gap Count] - PriorGaps, PriorGaps)
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(PriorGaps), "#5A6775", Change <= 0, "#1E7B3C", Change <= 0.10, "#8A5A00", "#B42318")

measures.name: After-Hours Coverage Status
measures.expression:
VAR Coverage = [After-Hours Coverage %]
VAR Target = [Coverage Target %]
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(Coverage),
        "– No data",
        SWITCH(TRUE(), Coverage >= Target, "✓ Meets", Coverage >= Target - 0.005, "⚠ Below", "✕ Below")
            & " " & FORMAT(Target, "0%") & " target  ·  " & [After-Hours Coverage Gaps] + 0 & " unstaffed"
    )

measures.name: After-Hours Coverage Status Color
measures.expression:
VAR Coverage = [After-Hours Coverage %]
VAR Target = [Coverage Target %]
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Coverage), "#5A6775", Coverage >= Target, "#1E7B3C", Coverage >= Target - 0.005, "#8A5A00", "#B42318")

measures.name: After-Hours Load Status
measures.description: Context, not a pass/fail KPI: after-hours share of incident load next to after-hours share of rostered shifts.
measures.expression:
VAR IncidentShare = [After-Hours Incident Share %]
VAR ShiftShare = [After-Hours Shift Share %]
RETURN
    IF(
        ISBLANK(IncidentShare),
        "– No data",
        "ⓘ " & FORMAT(IncidentShare, "0%") & " of incidents (7pm-7am) vs " & FORMAT(ShiftShare, "0%") & " of shifts"
    )

measures.name: Escalation Fill
measures.expression:
VAR Rate = [Escalation Rate %]
VAR Target = [Escalation Rate Target %]
RETURN
    SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(Rate), "#B8C2CC", Rate <= Target, "#2E7D46", Rate <= Target + 0.03, "#C07F12", "#B42318")

measures.name: Shift Type Label
measures.description: Row label for the unstaffed-shift register (symbol + words).
measures.expression:
VAR AfterHoursShifts = CALCULATE([Shifts Required], Fact_OnCallRoster[AfterHoursFlag] = 1)
RETURN
    IF([Shifts Required] > 0, IF(AfterHoursShifts > 0, "☾ After-hours", "☀ Business hours"))

filters.expression:
VAR CurrentUserServiceLines =
    CALCULATETABLE(
        VALUES(Security_UserServiceLine[ServiceLine]),
        Security_UserServiceLine[UserPrincipalName] = USERNAME()
    )
VAR IsExecutiveViewer =
    CALCULATE(
        COUNTROWS(Security_UserServiceLine),
        Security_UserServiceLine[UserPrincipalName] = USERNAME(),
        Security_UserServiceLine[ServiceLine] = "ALL"
    ) > 0
RETURN
    IsExecutiveViewer || Dim_Application[ServiceLine] IN CurrentUserServiceLines
